listing.name: Mario Strikers Charged (Recharged)
listing.summary: A Mario Strikers Charged port with project-reported complete play, audio, movies, saves and controller modes. Nintendo WFC online is unavailable. Project packages include the Recharged app/player and launcher: select your own supported Wii disc and follow first-start prompts for your platform. Source compilation is a separate route. The launcher manages in-place updates. Documented platforms are Windows x64, Linux x86-64/Vulkan, SteamOS 3.7+, and Apple Silicon/Intel macOS 15+. The first release entry was the test-pr74 prerelease; it is not an established stable selection. Exact accepted game revision/hashes and BIOS/firmware needs remain unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
